name: Oxi Slides
description: Read .pptx decks in Orca as slides, and play them full screen. Made for decks your agents write: the tab redraws when the file changes. Laid out by the Oxi engine (Rust + WebAssembly); nothing leaves the machine.

cover.alt: Oxi Slides showing a deck titled Q4 Launch Plan: slide thumbnails on the left, the title slide on the right

screenshots.alt: A Japanese deck in Oxi Slides showing a slide with a budget table: item, owner, budget and status columns
screenshots.caption: Tables and Japanese text, laid out by the Oxi engine

screenshots.alt: A timeline slide with four milestones from October to January, drawn as circles on a line above coloured boxes
screenshots.caption: Shapes and colours as the deck defines them
